visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Kai stands outdoors on a city sidewalk in Taipei, with the iconic Taipei 101 building rising in the background under a cloudy sky. He wears a cream-colored sweatshirt and a black backpack strap across his shoulder, smiling broadly and gesturing with one finger as he speaks directly into the camera. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a skincare salon where Kai lies on a massage bed with a white towel wrapped around his hair. A staff member in a dark uniform applies a thick white cream from a tube labeled Alitenice to his face, while the brightly lit room contains medical-grade skin analysis equipment. (3) A sequence of product display shots features glass shelves packed with white and gold boxes and bottles of Alitenice skincare products. In a mirror reflection, Kai is seen recording himself holding his smartphone, surrounded by neatly organized jars of creams and serums in a well-lit retail area. (4) Kai enters a hidden alleyway clinic called 'Camilla Professional Skincare Workshop,' greeted by a friendly woman. Inside, he meets Pan Jie, an older professional woman in a light green knit dress who waves warmly. The office is decorated with bookshelves, a red sofa, and traditional wall hangings. (5) A detailed montage shows Pan Jie performing a facial extraction on Kai. Wearing white gloves and a professional magnifying visor, she carefully uses cotton pads to press out impurities from his nose and chin area. Kai's eyes are closed, showing occasional slight winces of sensation. (6) Post-treatment, Kai shows off his radiant skin, touching his smooth cheek in a close-up that emphasizes the results. He then holds up various Alitenice products, including Glycoderm and AHA's Line, for the camera to see clearly. Finally, he stands with a branded shopping bag, waving goodbye alongside Pan Jie.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a bright, energetic pop-style acoustic guitar track with a steady beat. Kai’s voice is the primary signal, characterized by high clarity, a fast speech rate, and a friendly, enthusiastic tone. Faint urban environmental noise like distant traffic is audible but kept well below the vocal level. (2) A transition occurs as the acoustics shift to an indoor room environment with slight natural resonance. Kai introduces Pan Jie, whose voice has a lower pitch, slower tempo, and a calm, professional delivery style. The background music ducks slightly to allow the conversational dialogue to remain prominent and clear. (3) A new phase is marked by the sound of a plastic tube being squeezed and the soft rustling of cotton pads. These incidental noises are crisp and indicate a high-fidelity field recording. The BGM maintains a consistent upbeat mood, supporting the positive testimonial narrative without masking the specific sound effects. (4) In the final phase, the music swells slightly as Kai provides a summary narration. His vocal intensity remains moderate but carries a tone of sincere admiration. A subtle digital 'ding' sound effect coincides with product highlights. The track ends with a clean fade-out of both speech and background music.
